title: Acceptance read of the counting host
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be finite Boolean words, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine over empty input with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$, and let $	au$ be the configuration built from $w$, $s$, and $c$ using state maps $S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ and $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$. The overflow test is false and the input head of $\tau$ scans no symbol if and only if $|s|+|c\text{'s output}|=|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, state set $S$, and empty input
the embedding and return state maps have the stated Boolean-flag domains and codomain $H$
replaced:
In the counting-host embedding of a source configuration, the conjunction of
the negated overflow flag with the test that the native input read is blank
holds exactly when the candidate's length plus the source's output length
equals the input length.
